sentences.en: Alex Burns on the hidden infrastructure of influence and persuasion behind Bloomberg's campaign and the dilemma that it poses for Democrats.
sentences.zh: 亚历克斯·伯恩斯将带我们了解布隆伯格竞选活动背后隐藏的影响力和游说机制，以及这给民主党人带来的困境。

sentences.zh: 今天是星期二。

So, Alex, happy Valentine's Day.
sentences.zh: 那么，亚历克斯，情人节快乐。

sentences.en: Happy Valentine's Day.
sentences.zh: 情人节快乐。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: You know, in honor of Valentine's Day, I want you to watch this ad, Alex, and read what's being played on the screen.
sentences.zh: 你知道，为了庆祝情人节，我想让你看看这则广告，亚历克斯，并读一读屏幕上播放的内容。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: It says,
sentences.zh: 上面写着，

sentences.en: Roses are red.
sentences.zh: 玫瑰是红的。

sentences.en: Violets are blue.
sentences.zh: 紫罗兰是蓝的。

sentences.en: Your associates are criminals.
sentences.zh: 你的同僚是罪犯。

sentences.en: What does that make you?
sentences.zh: 那你是怎么回事？

sentences.en: America deserves better.
sentences.zh: 美国值得更好的。

sentences.en: Defeat Trump.
sentences.zh: 打败特朗普。

sentences.en: And it says,
sentences.zh: 上面还写着，

sentences.en: Paid for by Mike Bloomberg 2020.
sentences.zh: 由迈克·布隆伯格2020竞选团队出资。

sentences.en: Alex, what are we seeing here?
sentences.zh: 亚历克斯，我们看到了什么？

sentences.en: Well, we're seeing the kind of in-your-face taunting of the president's former associates who are in jail or about to go to jail.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我们看到的是对总统那些身陷囹圄或即将入狱的前同僚们的一种当面嘲讽。

sentences.en: People like Roger Stone and Paul Manafort, their faces sort of surrounded by hearts and flowers.
sentences.zh: 像罗杰·斯通和保罗·马纳福特这样的人，他们的脸被爱心和鲜花包围着。

sentences.en: And that all adds up to this crowd-pleasing taunt directed at the president by this campaign that has enough money to do anything.
sentences.zh: 这一切加起来，就成了这场竞选活动针对总统的一场讨好大众的嘲讽，他们有足够的钱去做任何事。

sentences.en: What kind of money are we talking about?
sentences.zh: 我们说的是什么样的资金规模？

sentences.en: Well, we're talking about at least $400 million so far.
sentences.zh: 嗯，到目前为止至少有4亿美元。

sentences.en: That's an astonishing sum of money for any campaign, let alone a campaign that has only existed for about three months.
sentences.zh: 对于任何竞选活动来说，这都是一笔惊人的巨款，更不用说一个只存在了大约三个月的竞选团队了。

sentences.en: And that $400 million has gone heavily into TV advertising, a lot of digital advertising, a lot of polling,
sentences.zh: 这4亿美元主要投入到了电视广告、大量的数字广告和民意调查中，

sentences.en: an enormous amount of staff that they say that they have over 2,000 people on staff right now.
sentences.zh: 还有庞大的员工队伍，他们说现在有超过2000名员工。

sentences.en: That's larger than most campaigns are in a general election.
sentences.zh: 这比大多数大选中的竞选团队规模都要大。

sentences.en: And this is a primary campaign.
sentences.zh: 而这还只是初选阶段。

sentences.en: And it is only February.
sentences.zh: 现在才2月。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And our reporting is that Mike Bloomberg has essentially directed his campaign to spend whatever it takes.
sentences.zh: 我们的报道显示，迈克·布隆伯格基本上指示他的竞选团队不惜一切代价进行投入。

sentences.en: And is all that spending working?
sentences.zh: 那么所有这些支出有效果吗？

sentences.en: Well, it's gotten him pretty far in not a lot of time.
sentences.zh: 嗯，他在短时间内已经取得了相当大的进展。

sentences.en: He has gone from not a candidate to somewhere in the double-digit range in the polls.
sentences.zh: 他从一个非候选人变成了民调中达到两位数支持率的人。

sentences.en: He's either second or third in a lot of national polls, depending on what time period exactly it was taken in.
sentences.zh: 在许多全国性民调中，他要么排在第二，要么排在第三，具体取决于民调是在什么时间段进行的。

sentences.en: He's caught up in some places to Joe Biden, who has obviously had a bit of a rough patch recently.
sentences.zh: 他在某些地方已经追上了乔·拜登，后者最近显然经历了一段艰难时期。

sentences.en: And so if the theory of the Mike Bloomberg campaign was spend whatever it takes in the winter so that if Joe Biden takes a dive, you're the guy waiting,
sentences.zh: 所以，如果迈克·布隆伯格竞选团队的策略是在冬天不惜一切代价投入，这样如果乔·拜登表现下滑，你就是那个候补人选，

sentences.en: I would say that strategy has worked pretty well so far.
sentences.zh: 我会说这个策略到目前为止非常有效。

sentences.en: And I'm reminded of the fact that it has worked without Mike Bloomberg ever even showing up on the debate stage, which is normally how a candidate rises in the polls.
sentences.zh: 我还要提醒一点，这一切的成功甚至是在迈克·布隆伯格从未登上辩论舞台的情况下实现的，而这通常是候选人提升民调支持率的方式。

sentences.en: In some ways, it might work because Mike Bloomberg hasn't showed up on the debate stage yet.
sentences.zh: 在某些方面，这可能正是因为迈克·布隆伯格还没有参加辩论。

sentences.en: And I'm not just saying that to be sort of snarky, that he has managed to create this idealized version of Michael Bloomberg.
sentences.zh: 我这么说并不是为了讽刺，而是他成功地塑造了一个理想化的迈克尔·布隆伯格形象。

sentences.en: Anyone hear the slogan, Mike will get it done?
sentences.zh: 有人听过这个口号吗：迈克能搞定？

sentences.en: And broadcast it to the country.
sentences.zh: 并向全国广播。

sentences.en: OK, let me tell you what it is.
sentences.zh: 好吧，让我告诉你这是什么。

sentences.en: With these hundreds of millions of dollars in television ads.
sentences.zh: 伴随着数亿美元的电视广告。

sentences.en: As president, I'll offer common sense plans and I will get it done.
sentences.zh: 作为总统，我会提供常识性的计划，并且我会搞定它。

sentences.en: So let's stay on the offensive.
sentences.zh: 所以让我们保持进攻态势。

sentences.en: So this idea that Michael Bloomberg is trying to buy the Democratic primary or at least buy his way into it, it's not untrue at this point.
sentences.zh: 所以，迈克尔·布隆伯格试图买下民主党初选，或者至少是花钱买入场券的说法，在这一点上并非不实。

sentences.en: No, his position in this race is totally inseparable from the amount of money that he has spent on his campaign.
sentences.zh: 没错，他在这次竞选中的地位与他在竞选上投入的资金是完全分不开的。

sentences.en: We had two people dive into this race at the 11th hour.
sentences.zh: 我们在最后一刻有两个人加入了这场竞选。

sentences.en: One was Mike Bloomberg with his $400 million campaign.
sentences.zh: 一个是拥有4亿美元竞选资金的迈克·布隆伯格。

sentences.en: The other was Deval Patrick, the two-term governor of Massachusetts, one of the few African-American governors in American history.
sentences.zh: 另一个是德瓦尔·帕特里克，马萨诸塞州两任州长，美国历史上为数不多的非裔州长之一。

sentences.en: Mike Bloomberg is now somewhere in the mid-teens in the polls.
sentences.zh: 迈克·布隆伯格现在的民调支持率在百分之十几左右。

sentences.en: Deval Patrick dropped out after the New Hampshire primary.
sentences.zh: 德瓦尔·帕特里克在新罕布什尔州初选后退出了。

sentences.en: And in fact, Mike Bloomberg, who was not on the ballot in New Hampshire, got more write-in votes in that state than Deval Patrick got as a candidate listed on the ballot.
sentences.zh: 事实上，没有出现在新罕布什尔州选票上的迈克·布隆伯格，在该州获得的补选投票数，比作为正式候选人出现在选票上的德瓦尔·帕特里克还要多。

sentences.en: It's the power of television advertising in a state that overlaps heavily with TV markets that Michael Bloomberg is in all the time.
sentences.zh: 这就是电视广告在迈克尔·布隆伯格一直覆盖的电视市场重叠地区所产生的威力。

sentences.en: But if you think his spending in this campaign has been consequential, the picture is actually much broader and deeper than that.
sentences.zh: 但如果你认为他在这次竞选中的支出很有影响力，那么实际情况要比这更广泛、更深远。

sentences.en: He has been spending not hundreds of millions of dollars over months,
sentences.zh: 他花费的不仅仅是几个月内数亿美元的资金，

sentences.en: but billions of dollars over years to build a political and philanthropic empire for himself and a national profile and network of influence that we are now seeing applied in so many ways in this race.
sentences.zh: 而是多年来数十亿美元的投入，为自己建立了一个政治和慈善帝国，以及一个全国性的形象和影响力网络，我们现在看到这些在这次竞选中以多种方式发挥作用。

sentences.en: And this, Alex, is the investigation that you have been working on these past few weeks.
sentences.zh: 亚历克斯，这就是你过去几周一直在调查的内容。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: My colleague Nick Kulish and I have spent actually the last couple months sort of combing through all the spending that Mike Bloomberg has done in the political arena and in philanthropy,
sentences.zh: 我和我的同事尼克·库利什实际上花了过去几个月的时间，梳理了迈克·布隆伯格在政治领域和慈善事业上的所有支出，

sentences.en: essentially over the course of his public career and trying to track where that money has gone and what kind of friends it has made for him.
sentences.zh: 基本上是他整个公共职业生涯的支出，并试图追踪这些钱的去向，以及它为他结交了什么样的朋友。

sentences.en: Mike Bloomberg is worth estimated around $60 billion.
sentences.zh: 迈克·布隆伯格的身价估计在600亿美元左右。

sentences.en: It's a fortune built on a financial information and news company, and he has used that money to advance a whole range of causes that he personally cares about,
sentences.zh: 这是一笔建立在金融信息和新闻公司基础上的财富，他利用这些钱来推动他个人关心的各种事业，

sentences.en: as well as the politicians who he sees as strong leaders for those causes for well over a decade at this point.
sentences.zh: 以及他认为在这些事业上是强有力领导者的政治人物，到目前为止已经超过十年了。

sentences.en: Those activities have accelerated dramatically since he left office as mayor.
sentences.zh: 自他卸任市长以来，这些活动显著加速了。

sentences.en: Which was 2013.
Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And what are some examples of the causes and the characters who've received this money?
sentences.zh: 那么，收到这些钱的事业和人物有哪些例子呢？

sentences.en: He gives an enormous amount of money to causes like fighting climate change, like advancing gun control policies, and more recently,
sentences.zh: 他向应对气候变化、推进枪支管制政策等事业投入了巨额资金，最近，

sentences.en: like electing Democrats for the sake of electing Democrats.
sentences.zh: 他还为了选举民主党人而资助民主党人。

sentences.en: And what's complicated about that?
sentences.zh: 那这有什么复杂之处呢？

sentences.en: Well, in the context of an election, what's complicated is that you have somebody who can make or break your cause or organization
sentences.zh: 嗯，在选举背景下，复杂之处在于，你拥有一个可以用个人支票簿决定你的事业、组织

sentences.en: or campaign with his personal checkbook with his personal checkbook?
sentences.zh: 或竞选活动成败的人，用他的个人支票簿？

sentences.en: So one example, at the end of September in 2018, Emily's List, the premier pro-choice women's Democratic group in the country, is hosting a major fundraising luncheon in New York.
sentences.zh: 举个例子，2018年9月底，全国首屈一指的民主党女性支持堕胎权组织“艾米丽名单”（Emily's List）在纽约举办了一场大型筹款午宴。

sentences.en: Every announced speaker is a prominent Democratic woman, except for one, who's Mike Bloomberg.
sentences.zh: 除了迈克·布隆伯格之外，每一位宣布的演讲者都是杰出的民主党女性。

sentences.en: Shortly before the luncheon, I am out in Seattle as Mike Bloomberg is engaging in all kinds of public-minded activities.
sentences.zh: 在午宴前不久，我在西雅图，当时迈克·布隆伯格正在参与各种具有公共意识的活动。

sentences.en: And we do an interview, and I ask him about the Me Too movement.
sentences.zh: 我们做了一次采访，我问他关于“我也是”（Me Too）运动的看法。

sentences.en: He is somebody who is trying to position himself now nationally as a progressive.
sentences.zh: 他现在正试图将自己定位为全国范围内的进步派。

sentences.en: Tonight, new questions about Michael Bloomberg and the company he founded that made him a billionaire.
sentences.zh: 今晚，关于迈克尔·布隆伯格和他创立的让他成为亿万富翁的公司的质疑声不断。

sentences.en: But he himself has been accused of making all kinds of crude remarks to and about women.
sentences.zh: 但他本人也被指控对女性发表过各种粗俗的言论。

sentences.en: You have been accused in the past of making lewd and sexist comments and fostering a frat-like culture at your company that was uncomfortable for some female employees.
sentences.zh: 你过去曾被指控发表淫秽和性别歧视言论，并在公司内部营造了一种让一些女性员工感到不舒服的兄弟会文化。

sentences.en: ABC's actually spoken to several women who want to share their stories, but you won't release them from their NDAs.
sentences.zh: 美国广播公司（ABC）实际上采访了几位想分享她们故事的女性，但你拒绝解除她们的保密协议（NDA）。

sentences.en: As Senator Warren put it, she was here last week, she said, if your company has an enviable record, what do you have to hide?
sentences.zh: 正如沃伦参议员上周在这里所说，如果你的公司有令人羡慕的记录，你有什么好隐瞒的？

sentences.en: We don't have anything to hide, but we made legal agreements, which both sides wanted to keep certain things from coming out.
sentences.zh: 我们没有什么可隐瞒的，但我们签署了法律协议，双方都希望防止某些事情泄露出去。

sentences.en: They have a right to do that.
sentences.zh: 他们有权这样做。

sentences.en: As a corporate leader, he ran a company that has faced serious discrimination allegations.
sentences.zh: 作为企业领导者，他经营的公司曾面临严重的歧视指控。

sentences.en: Did I ever tell a body joke?
sentences.zh: 我有没有开过关于身体的玩笑？

sentences.en: Yeah, sure I did.
sentences.zh: 是的，当然开过。

sentences.en: And do I regret it?
sentences.zh: 我后悔吗？

sentences.en: Yes, it's embarrassing.
sentences.zh: 是的，这很尴尬。

sentences.en: But, you know, that's the way I grew up.
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道，这就是我成长的方式。

sentences.en: A body.
sentences.zh: 身体。

sentences.en: A body.
sentences.zh: 身体。

sentences.en: So when I ask him about this, his response is to say that a lot of the things that he has heard coming out of the Me Too movement are alarming,
sentences.zh: 所以当我问他这个问题时，他的回应是说他听到的很多关于“我也是”运动的内容令人震惊，

sentences.en: but he doesn't know how true they are.
sentences.zh: 但他不知道这些内容的真实性如何。

sentences.en: And he specifically raises the case of Charlie Rose, the disgraced news anchor who for years taped his show in the offices of Mike Bloomberg's company.
sentences.zh: 他特别提到了查理·罗斯的案例，这位声名狼藉的新闻主播多年来一直在迈克·布隆伯格公司的办公室录制节目。

sentences.en: And is a friend of Mike Bloomberg.
sentences.zh: 而且他是迈克·布隆伯格的朋友。

sentences.en: And is a personal friend of longstanding.
sentences.zh: 并且是多年的私人朋友。

sentences.en: And he said that essentially he wasn't going to judge him one way or another until a court adjudicated the issue.
sentences.zh: 他说基本上在法院裁决此事之前，他不会对他做出任何评判。

sentences.en: And then he acknowledged that a court would probably never adjudicate the issue.
sentences.zh: 然后他承认法院可能永远不会裁决此事。

sentences.en: This is not a sentiment in keeping with the progressive moment.
sentences.zh: 这种情绪与进步派运动并不一致。

sentences.en: At all.
sentences.zh: 完全不一致。

sentences.en: Certainly not in keeping with the perspective of Emily's LiSt.
sentences.zh: 当然与“艾米丽名单”的观点也不一致。

sentences.en: In fact, you might even say it's the kind of thing that would get a person disinvited from a speaking slot at a luncheon for Emily's LiSt.
sentences.zh: 事实上，你甚至可以说，这足以让一个人被取消在“艾米丽名单”午宴上的演讲资格。

sentences.en: And it very nearly did.
sentences.zh: 而且差一点就发生了。

sentences.en: What our reporting indicates is that Emily's List was mortified by his comments in that interview and that there was a very serious internal debate about whether to ask him not to appear at the luncheon.
sentences.zh: 我们的报道显示，“艾米丽名单”对他在那次采访中的言论感到非常震惊，内部曾就是否要求他不要出席午宴进行了非常严肃的辩论。

sentences.en: But that ultimately the leaders of the organization decided that he was somebody they could not afford to alienate.
sentences.zh: 但最终该组织的领导人认为，他是一个他们无法承受得罪的人。

sentences.en: And what ended up happening was in late September, Mike Bloomberg got up at this Emily's List luncheon in New York.
sentences.zh: 最终发生的事情是，9月下旬，迈克·布隆伯格在纽约的这场“艾米丽名单”午宴上发表了讲话。

sentences.en: In the background, the Kavanaugh hearings are raging in Washington.
sentences.zh: 背景中，卡瓦诺听证会在华盛顿正如火如荼地进行。

sentences.en: And he announces that he is going to spend more money helping elect women to office than anyone else in history.
sentences.zh: 他宣布他将投入比历史上任何人更多的资金来帮助女性竞选公职。

sentences.en: He ends up spending more than $100 million supporting Democrats in the midterm elections, including helping elect 21 new members to the House of Representatives.
sentences.zh: 他最终花费了超过1亿美元支持民主党人参加中期选举，包括帮助21名新成员当选众议员。

sentences.en: Of the 21 winning members he supported, 15 were women.
sentences.zh: 在他支持的21名获胜成员中，有15名是女性。

sentences.en: So if there are things about his worldview and his personal conduct and his business record that make progressive women very uncomfortable,
sentences.zh: 所以，如果他的世界观、个人行为和商业记录中有让进步派女性感到非常不舒服的地方，

sentences.en: there is nothing uncomfortable about the way he used his checkbook in 2018.
sentences.zh: 那么他在2018年使用支票簿的方式却没有任何让人不舒服的地方。

sentences.en: What's another example of the complexity of Mike Bloomberg's money?
sentences.zh: 迈克·布隆伯格的资金复杂性还有什么其他例子吗？

sentences.en: So I spoke to a number of people, current and former employees of the Center for American Progress, major liberal think tank in Washington, D.C.,
sentences.zh: 我采访了一些人，包括华盛顿特区主要自由派智库美国进步中心（Center for American Progress）的现任和前任员工，

sentences.en: about a report that was being prepared in February of 2015.
sentences.zh: 关于一份在2015年2月准备的报告。

sentences.en: It was about Islamophobia in America.
sentences.zh: 那是关于美国伊斯兰恐惧症的报告。

sentences.en: And we reviewed a draft of the report.
sentences.zh: 我们审阅了该报告的草稿。

sentences.en: And the draft included a whole chapter of more than 4,000 words about the New York Police Department under Mike Bloomberg and its surveillance of Muslim Americans.
sentences.zh: 草稿中包含整整一章超过4000字的内容，关于迈克·布隆伯格治下的纽约警察局及其对美国穆斯林的监视。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: This was a very invasive style of policing.
sentences.zh: 这是一种非常具有侵入性的警务风格。

sentences.en: It involved going into mosques, getting into communities with undercover police officers.
sentences.zh: 它涉及进入清真寺，通过卧底警察渗透到社区中。

sentences.en: It was highly unusual.
sentences.zh: 这非常不寻常。

sentences.en: It was.
sentences.zh: 确实。

sentences.en: And in the draft of this report, it was held up as an example of really the most sophisticated, institutionalized form of Islamophobia and discrimination in law enforcement.
sentences.zh: 在这份报告的草稿中，它被视为执法部门中最复杂、制度化的伊斯兰恐惧症和歧视的典型例子。

sentences.en: Pretty damning.
sentences.zh: 相当令人震惊。

sentences.en: Except it was never published.
sentences.zh: 但它从未发表过。

sentences.en: When the draft was submitted, one senior official at the Center for American Progress pointed out that if it were published in its current form,
sentences.zh: 当草稿提交时，美国进步中心的一位高级官员指出，如果以目前的形式发表，

sentences.en: it would draw a strong response from Bloomberg's world.
sentences.zh: 它会引起布隆伯格阵营的强烈反应。

sentences.en: And when the report was published, not only was the chapter entirely removed, but Mike Bloomberg's name was never mentioned.
sentences.zh: 当报告最终发表时，不仅那一章被完全删除了，而且迈克·布隆伯格的名字也从未被提及。

sentences.en: Not once.
sentences.zh: 一次都没有。

sentences.en: Not once.
sentences.zh: 一次都没有。

sentences.en: And does Mike Bloomberg give to the Center for American Progress,
sentences.zh: 那么迈克·布隆伯格会向美国进步中心捐款吗，

sentences.en: or is this about the very real possibility that someday he will give or he will give to causes near and dear to this group?
sentences.zh: 还是说这与他未来可能会捐款，或者会向该组织密切关注的事业捐款的现实可能性有关？

sentences.en: It's both.
sentences.zh: 两者皆是。

sentences.en: At the time the draft was submitted, Bloomberg had already given nearly $1.5 million in grants to CAP.
sentences.zh: 在草案提交时，彭博已经向美国进步中心（CAP）提供了近150万美元的资助。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: Since then, he's given an additional $400,000 as far as we know.
sentences.zh: 据我们所知，此后他又额外提供了40万美元。

sentences.en: What do these two stories tell you?
sentences.zh: 这两个故事说明了什么？

sentences.en: What they tell you is that Mike Bloomberg's money has become this gravitational force, unlike any other in democratic politics,
sentences.zh: 它们说明迈克·彭博的资金已经成为一种引力，在民主政治中是独一无二的，

sentences.en: where people are tailoring their activities and their agendas to try to align themselves with him, even if he's not explicitly asking them to.
sentences.zh: 人们为了试图与他保持一致，正在调整自己的活动和议程，即使他并没有明确要求他们这样做。

sentences.en: In the case of that CAP report, the folks on the Mike Bloomberg side said they were never aware of this report being prepared or the controversy around its preparation.
sentences.zh: 就那份CAP报告而言，迈克·彭博一方的人表示，他们从未意识到这份报告的准备工作，也从未意识到围绕其准备工作的争议。

sentences.en: We have no reason to believe—
sentences.zh: 我们没有理由相信——

sentences.en: It's self-censorship.
sentences.zh: 这是自我审查。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: We have no reason to believe, based on our reporting, that anyone who works directly for Bloomberg said, you need to remove that chapter.
sentences.zh: 根据我们的报道，我们没有理由相信任何直接为彭博工作的人说过“你需要删除那一章”。

sentences.en: But the chapter was removed.
sentences.zh: 但那一章确实被删除了。

sentences.en: In other words, the democratic world wakes up every day with some level of fear that they might offend Mike Bloomberg and a desire to please him.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，民主党世界每天醒来时，都带着某种程度的恐惧，担心可能会冒犯迈克·彭博，同时也渴望取悦他。

sentences.en: And this is what you're now seeing happen on a national scale in this campaign.
sentences.zh: 这就是你现在在这次竞选中看到的全国范围内的现象。

sentences.en: It's not that you've seen some massive stampede of support towards Mike Bloomberg within the democratic establishment.
sentences.zh: 并不是说你看到了民主党建制派内部对迈克·彭博的支持出现了大规模的狂潮。

sentences.en: But what you have seen is people who may have been critical of him in the past when he was a Republican, not necessarily speaking up so loudly in this campaign.
sentences.zh: 但你看到的是，那些在彭博担任共和党人时可能对他持批评态度的人，在这次竞选中不一定那么大声疾呼了。

sentences.en: You have seen people who might be offended by elements of his record as mayor coming out and either endorsing him for president or calling him a very plausible contender for this democratic nomination.
sentences.zh: 你已经看到那些可能对他担任市长期间的记录感到不满的人，出来支持他竞选总统，或者称他为民主党提名的有力竞争者。

sentences.en: And you have seen, of course, on the strength of all that television advertising,
sentences.zh: 当然，你已经看到，凭借所有这些电视广告的力量，

sentences.en: Mike Bloomberg tell a story about who he is and what he has done with his money that Democratic voters seem to find pretty appealing.
sentences.zh: 迈克·彭博讲述了一个关于他是谁以及他如何使用资金的故事，民主党选民似乎觉得这很有吸引力。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》应用程序？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 解锁了？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to the Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 每个人都知道你需要订阅《时报》才能获取所有报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore the Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但如果你能免费试用《时报》一个月，而无需输入信用卡信息呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download the New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你第一次下载《纽约时报》应用程序时，你在该应用中的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 用一个月的时间越过付费墙，看看《时报》订阅者每天都能得到什么。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to the New York Times, download the Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没有订阅《纽约时报》，请立即下载《时报》应用程序，并获得30天的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: So, Alex, just how much money are we actually talking about?
sentences.zh: 那么，亚历克斯，我们实际上在谈论多少钱？

sentences.en: What did the investigation that you and Nick did find about the scale of this?
sentences.zh: 你和尼克所做的调查发现了这种规模的什么情况？

sentences.en: I covered City Hall for many years when Bloomberg was mayor.
sentences.zh: 彭博担任市长时，我报道市政厅多年。

sentences.en: And when I covered City Hall, we actually did an investigation into how much money the mayor was giving away during that period.
sentences.zh: 当我报道市政厅时，我们确实对市长在那段时期捐出了多少钱进行了调查。

sentences.en: And I remember the number being pretty staggering.
sentences.zh: 我记得那个数字相当惊人。

sentences.en: It was.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: It was in the range of $260 million.
sentences.zh: 大约在2.6亿美元左右。

sentences.en: And what Nick and I found in this investigation is that at the time that story was written, the true number was about 10 times that.
sentences.zh: 尼克和我在这次调查中发现，在那篇报道撰写时，真实的数字大约是那个数字的10倍。

sentences.en: I'm sorry?
sentences.zh: 抱歉？

sentences.en: Yeah, it was about 10.
sentences.zh: 是的，大约是10倍。

sentences.en: You know, look, you did a great job with the information that was available.
sentences.zh: 你知道，看，你利用现有的信息做得很好。

sentences.en: In the course of reporting this story, though,
sentences.zh: 然而，在报道这个故事的过程中，

sentences.en: what became clear to us was that there is the philanthropy that we know of that's disclosed on tax forms or that's announced publicly.
sentences.zh: 我们清楚地认识到，有一种我们所知的慈善事业，是在税务表格上披露的，或者是公开宣布的。

sentences.en: And then there's other kinds of philanthropy that Bloomberg engages in that is much, much harder to track down.
sentences.zh: 还有其他类型的慈善事业，彭博参与其中，但要追踪起来要困难得多。

sentences.en: In fact, impossible to track down without cooperation of some kind from Mike Bloomberg himself.
sentences.zh: 事实上，如果没有迈克·彭博本人的某种合作，是不可能追踪到的。

sentences.en: And what it all adds up to is more than $10 billion of giving on philanthropy and spending on politics.
sentences.zh: 所有这些加起来，他在慈善事业上的捐赠和在政治上的支出超过了100亿美元。

sentences.en: And it's overwhelmingly weighted towards philanthropy.
sentences.zh: 而且绝大部分都偏向于慈善事业。

sentences.en: So when we think of the spending on this campaign or on his mayoral campaigns or on the Democratic Party,
sentences.zh: 所以当我们想到这次竞选、他的市长竞选或民主党的支出时，

sentences.en: it is a fairly small fraction of the money that Mike Bloomberg gives away as a matter of course.
sentences.zh: 这只是迈克·彭博作为惯例捐出的钱中相当小的一部分。

sentences.en: Alex, I think I understand the power of that philanthropic giving from the examples you gave around Emily's List and the Center for American Progress.
sentences.zh: 亚历克斯，我想我理解了你围绕“艾米莉名单”（Emily's List）和美国进步中心所举的例子中，那种慈善捐赠的力量。

sentences.en: Can you give us a little bit more a sense of his giving to candidates?
sentences.zh: 你能让我们更了解一下他给候选人的捐赠吗？

sentences.en: Well, for years, his political giving was really agenda-driven and issue-driven more than it was driven by the party label associated with a candidate.
sentences.zh: 嗯，多年来，他的政治捐赠更多是基于议程和议题的，而不是基于候选人所属的政党标签。

sentences.en: What our reporting showed is that Bloomberg has spent about $270 million on a pair of organizations, one that kind of grew out of the other.
sentences.zh: 我们的报道显示，彭博在两个组织上花费了大约2.7亿美元，其中一个是从另一个发展而来的。

sentences.en: The first is called Mayors Against Illegal Guns, which he operated from within City Hall.
sentences.zh: 第一个叫“市长反对非法枪支”，他在市政厅内运作该组织。

sentences.en: After the Sandy Hook shooting, that morphed into a group known as Everytown, now arguably the anchor gun control group in the country.
sentences.zh: 桑迪胡克小学枪击案后，它演变成了一个名为“Everytown”的组织，现在可以说是全国主要的枪支管制组织。

sentences.en: And what that money has gone to over the years has been a range of causes associated with the gun issue, whether it's Democratic candidates, Republican candidates,
sentences.zh: 多年来，这些钱用于与枪支问题相关的一系列事业，无论是民主党候选人、共和党候选人，

sentences.en: litigation related to gun laws, helping lawmakers in different states and cities draft gun laws,
sentences.zh: 与枪支法律相关的诉讼，帮助不同州和城市的立法者起草枪支法律，

sentences.en: and then defend them in court, providing cities and states that are thinking of passing gun control laws with data to justify it.
sentences.zh: 然后在法庭上为它们辩护，为考虑通过枪支管制法律的城市和州提供数据以证明其合理性。

sentences.en: And for years, he was a sort of party-neutral donor.
sentences.zh: 多年来，他一直是一个某种意义上的中立政党捐赠者。

sentences.en: If you were with him on guns, he was with you.
sentences.zh: 如果你在枪支问题上支持他，他就支持你。

sentences.en: And most of the people who were with him on guns were Democrats.
sentences.zh: 而在枪支问题上支持他的大多数人都是民主党人。

sentences.en: But if you were, for instance, Senator Pat Toomey, a very conservative Republican from Pennsylvania who agreed to introduce background checks legislation in the Senate,
sentences.zh: 但如果你是，例如，宾夕法尼亚州的保守派共和党参议员帕特·图米，他同意在参议院提出背景调查立法，

sentences.en: Mike Bloomberg ended up spending almost $12 million in the 2016 election helping Toomey get reelected.
sentences.zh: 迈克·彭博最终在2016年的选举中花费了近1200万美元帮助图米连任。

sentences.en: And is it clear to you that as with Mike Bloomberg's other philanthropic donations, that these political donations have resulted in the same kind of reticence to cross him,
sentences.zh: 你是否清楚，正如迈克·彭博的其他慈善捐赠一样，这些政治捐赠是否导致了同样的对他不敢违抗、

sentences.en: to challenge him?
sentences.zh: 不敢挑战的克制？

sentences.en: You know,
sentences.zh: 你知道，

sentences.en: one of the most vivid anecdotes that we heard about the gratitude that candidates feel to Mike Bloomberg came from just a couple weeks ago when he went to Capitol Hill to ask lawmakers there for their support in the presidential race.
sentences.zh: 我们听到的关于候选人对迈克·彭博感激之情的最生动的轶事之一，来自仅仅几周前，当时他去国会山请求那里的立法者在总统竞选中支持他。

sentences.en: And normally when a presidential candidate goes up to the Hill, they kind of go hat in hand meeting with members of Congress and saying, could I please have your support?
sentences.zh: 通常当总统候选人去国会山时，他们会表现得谦卑，与国会议员会面，说：“请问能得到您的支持吗？”

sentences.en: In at least one meeting that we heard about with the New Democrat Coalition, it's a group of moderates in the Democratic caucus.
sentences.zh: 在我们听说的至少一次与“新民主党联盟”（New Democrat Coalition）的会议中，这是一个民主党核心小组中的温和派团体。

sentences.en: Bloomberg sits down and the lawmakers go around the table introducing themselves to him.
sentences.zh: 彭博坐下来，立法者们围坐在桌子旁向他介绍自己。

sentences.en: And according to two people who were in the room, one after another began by saying, thank you so much.
sentences.zh: 据房间里的两个人说，他们一个接一个地开始说：“非常感谢。”

sentences.en: You spent this much in my race or you supported me in my last two elections.
sentences.zh: “你在我的竞选中花了这么多钱，或者你在我过去两次选举中支持了我。”

sentences.en: And many of those people have not endorsed him, but most of them haven't endorsed somebody else.
sentences.zh: 这些人中许多人并没有支持他，但他们大多数人也没有支持别人。

sentences.en: And the Bloomberg advisors that we have spoken to have, again,
sentences.zh: 而我们采访过的彭博顾问再次强调，

sentences.en: stressed that we have never promised or implied that you will get support in the future in exchange for an endorsement.
sentences.zh: “我们从未承诺或暗示过你会为了换取支持而在未来得到资助。”

sentences.en: But every Democratic member of Congress in a tough race can look at what Mike Bloomberg did for the party in 2018 and draw their own conclusions.
sentences.zh: 但每一位处于艰难竞选中的民主党国会议员都可以看看迈克·彭博在2018年为该党所做的事情，并得出自己的结论。

sentences.en: So how are we going to see all of this, everything that you've been describing here, play out in the Democratic primary as Bloomberg actually starts showing up on the ballot?
sentences.zh: 那么，随着彭博真正开始出现在选票上，我们将如何看到所有这一切，即你在这里描述的一切，在民主党初选中展开？

sentences.en: Well, what we've already seen in the Democratic primary is that as he's gone around the country,
sentences.zh: 嗯，我们在民主党初选中已经看到，随着他在全国各地奔走，

sentences.en: he has been able to reliably find important partners to appear with him or host him who have often benefited from his philanthropy or his political spending in the paSt.
sentences.zh: 他能够可靠地找到重要的合作伙伴与他一起露面或接待他，这些人往往在过去受益于他的慈善事业或政治支出。

sentences.en: Take the San Francisco Bay Area, you have had just in that one metro, Mike Bloomberg has spent on school board races, on ballot initiatives to tax soda and ban e-cigarettes.
sentences.zh: 以旧金山湾区为例，仅在那一个大都市区，迈克·彭博就在学校董事会竞选、对苏打水征税和禁止电子烟的投票倡议上投入了资金。

sentences.en: That's all political spending.
sentences.zh: 那都是政治支出。

sentences.en: And from his philanthropy, he has given out dozens of grants to museums and dance companies and climate organizations.
sentences.zh: 而且从他的慈善事业中，他向博物馆、舞蹈公司和气候组织发放了数十笔赠款。

sentences.en: And the mayor of San Francisco, one of the most prominent politicians in the state, has endorsed him for president.
sentences.zh: 而旧金山市长，该州最著名的政治家之一，已经支持他竞选总统。

sentences.en: Now, we can't say that Mayor London Breed endorsed Mike Bloomberg just because he has put all this money into San Francisco.
sentences.zh: 现在，我们不能说伦敦·布里德市长支持迈克·彭博仅仅是因为他把所有这些钱投入了旧金山。

sentences.en: But for a mayor who's thinking about who to support, it's just an inescapable factor to think about that this is a guy who has underwritten not just politicians here,
sentences.zh: 但对于一位正在考虑支持谁的市长来说，这是一个不可避免的因素，即这是一个不仅资助了这里的政治家，

sentences.en: but other institutions that make up kind of the civic and cultural backbone of the city.
sentences.zh: 而且资助了构成这座城市公民和文化支柱的其他机构的人。

sentences.en: None of the other candidates is really competing for this kind of support right now in the same way because they have been tied up in Iowa, New Hampshire,
sentences.zh: 目前没有其他候选人真正以同样的方式竞争这种支持，因为他们一直被困在爱荷华州、新罕布什尔州，

sentences.en: and now Nevada and South Carolina.
sentences.zh: 以及现在的内华达州和南卡罗来纳州。

sentences.en: And when they have been doing that, Mike Bloomberg has been jumping across the country on a private jet, meeting with prominent local officials,
sentences.zh: 当他们这样做的时候，迈克·彭博一直乘坐私人飞机在全国各地奔波，会见当地著名的官员，

sentences.en: many of them prominent African-American officials, to ask them to consider supporting his campaign.
sentences.zh: 其中许多是著名的非裔美国官员，请求他们考虑支持他的竞选。

sentences.en: And he has done that actually with quite a bit of success so far.
sentences.zh: 到目前为止，他实际上已经取得了相当大的成功。

sentences.en: And why is it important that he's cultivating black elected officials?
sentences.zh: 为什么他培养黑人当选官员很重要？

sentences.en: I think there are two big reasons.
sentences.zh: 我认为有两个主要原因。

sentences.en: One of them is that his own record as mayor is going to be troubling to a lot of African-American voters.
sentences.zh: 其中之一是，他自己作为市长的记录会让许多非裔美国选民感到不安。

sentences.en: His policies on law enforcement, his view of invasive searches largely targeting black and Hispanic men.
sentences.zh: 他在执法方面的政策，他对于主要针对黑人和西班牙裔男性的侵入性搜查的看法。

sentences.en: Stop and frisk.
sentences.zh: 拦截搜身。

sentences.en: Stop and frisk.
sentences.zh: 拦截搜身。

sentences.en: So if he is going to reassure African-Americans, who are the cornerstone of the Democratic Party, that he's an acceptable candidate,
sentences.zh: 所以，如果他要让作为民主党基石的非裔美国人相信他是一个可以接受的候选人，

sentences.en: he needs to convince leaders within the black community to help him make that case.
sentences.zh: 他需要说服黑人社区内的领导人帮助他证明这一点。

sentences.en: Well, good morning.
sentences.zh: 嗯，早上好。

sentences.en: Good morning.
sentences.zh: 早上好。

sentences.en: For all our guests, welcome to Stockton.
sentences.zh: 对于我们所有的客人，欢迎来到斯托克顿。

sentences.en: I'm excited.
sentences.zh: 我很兴奋。

sentences.en: When I was in California with Bloomberg late last year, he got the endorsement of the young black mayor of Stockton.
sentences.zh: 去年年底我和彭博在加利福尼亚州时，他得到了斯托克顿年轻黑人市长的支持。

sentences.en: We have to have a candidate with the record, with the resources and the relationships to not just make sure we beat Donald Trump,
sentences.zh: 我们必须有一位拥有记录、资源和人脉的候选人，不仅要确保我们击败唐纳德·特朗普，

sentences.en: but make sure something like Donald Trump never happens again.
sentences.zh: 还要确保像唐纳德·特朗普这样的人永远不会再发生。

sentences.en: Who is a very progressive guy on basically everything, who stood next to Bloomberg and, when they got a question about stop and frisk, said,
sentences.zh: 他是一个在基本上所有事情上都非常进步的人，他站在彭博旁边，当他们被问及拦截搜身时，他说，

sentences.en: I think we all recognize now in 2019 that Stockton, I think two things for me.
sentences.zh: “我想我们现在在2019年都认识到，斯托克顿，我想对我来说有两件事。”

sentences.en: Number one, if you look at every candidate in the field, there's an issue with criminal justice.
sentences.zh: “第一，如果你看看领域里的每一位候选人，刑事司法都有一个问题。”

sentences.en: You have folks who wrote the 94 crime bill, which created mass incarceration.
sentences.zh: “你有写过94年犯罪法案的人，这造成了大规模监禁。”

sentences.en: You have folks who voted for the 94 crime bill.
sentences.zh: “你有投票支持94年犯罪法案的人。”

sentences.en: You have folks who supported Ronald Reagan.
sentences.zh: “你有支持罗纳德·里根的人。”

sentences.en: So there's not a candidate in 2019 who had a criminal justice record.
sentences.zh: “所以2019年没有一位候选人拥有完美的刑事司法记录。”

sentences.en: That's where we are today.
sentences.zh: “这就是我们今天所处的位置。”

sentences.en: But I think the sign of a good leader is one more-
sentences.zh: “但我认为好领导者的标志是……”

sentences.en: Nobody in this campaign has a perfect record on law enforcement.
sentences.zh: 这次竞选中没有人拥有完美的执法记录。

sentences.en: And Mike Bloomberg has the resources and the record to defeat President Trump.
sentences.zh: 而迈克·彭博拥有击败特朗普总统的资源和记录。

sentences.en: I want to pause on this because for a black mayor to be asked about stop and frisk and to say, eh, no one's perfect,
sentences.zh: 我想在这里暂停一下，因为对于一位黑人市长来说，被问及拦截搜身并说“呃，没有人是完美的”，

sentences.en: the reason that would seem quite striking is that stop and frisk was a policing policy deemed unconstitutional,
sentences.zh: 之所以看起来非常引人注目，是因为拦截搜身是一项被认为违宪的警务政策，

sentences.en: as practiced in New York under the Bloomberg administration, that disproportionately targeted black and Latino men
sentences.zh: 正如在彭博政府下在纽约实施的那样，它不成比例地针对黑人和拉丁裔男性，

sentences.en: and by many accounts, not just humiliated them, but kind of generationally scarred the black community in New York.
sentences.zh: 而且据许多人说，不仅羞辱了他们，而且在某种程度上给纽约的黑人社区留下了代际创伤。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And it might get tougher as you see more and more video and audio of Mike Bloomberg talking about stop and frisk, as we have seen in the last few days.
sentences.zh: 而且随着你看到越来越多迈克·彭博谈论拦截搜身的视频和音频，正如我们在过去几天看到的那样，情况可能会变得更糟。

sentences.en: A scratchy recording of former New York City Mayor Michael Bloomberg has been circulating on social media since Tuesday,
sentences.zh: 自周二以来，一段前纽约市长迈克尔·彭博的刺耳录音一直在社交媒体上流传，

sentences.en: appearing to show the billionaire presidential candidate defending the city's stop and frisk policy in starkly racial terMs.
sentences.zh: 似乎显示这位亿万富翁总统候选人以极其种族化的措辞为该市的拦截搜身政策辩护。

sentences.en: Quote, we put all the cops in minority neighborhoods.
sentences.zh: 引用：“我们把所有的警察都放在少数族裔社区。”

sentences.en: Yes, that's true.
sentences.zh: 是的，那是真的。

sentences.en: Why do we do it?
sentences.zh: “我们为什么要这样做？”

sentences.en: Because that's where all the crime is.
sentences.zh: “因为那是所有犯罪发生的地方。”

sentences.en: A lot of these mayors don't particularly want to be on the hook for defending every offensive or divisive turn of phrase that Mike Bloomberg has used over the years.
sentences.zh: 许多市长并不特别想为迈克·彭博多年来使用的每一个冒犯性或分裂性的措辞承担辩护责任。

sentences.en: But at least on the surface level, there have been enough signals of reassurance.
sentences.zh: 但至少在表面上，已经有足够的安抚信号。

sentences.en: He has apologized for the policy that these mayors who see him as an ally on a whole lot of other things have been willing to get on his side in the primary.
sentences.zh: 他已经为该政策道歉，这些在其他许多事情上视他为盟友的市长们，已经愿意在初选中站在他这一边。

sentences.en: Because the only path for a moderate candidate to the Democratic nomination is at least with some significant support from black voters.
sentences.zh: 因为温和派候选人获得民主党提名的唯一途径，至少需要黑人选民的大力支持。

sentences.en: Right now, one of the biggest questions in the race is whether Joe Biden is going to hang on to the support that he has had from African-Americans all along,
sentences.zh: 现在，竞选中最大的问题之一是乔·拜登是否会保持他一直以来从非裔美国人那里获得的支持，

sentences.en: or whether as he struggles in these largely white early states, those voters are going to look elsewhere.
sentences.zh: 还是随着他在这些主要是白人的早期州陷入困境，这些选民会去寻找别处。

sentences.en: And what Mike Bloomberg hopes is that they will look to him.
sentences.zh: 而迈克·彭博希望他们会看向他。

sentences.en: And from everything you're saying, underlying that strategy of reaching out to African-American leaders, African-American elected officials,
sentences.zh: 根据你所说的一切，在接触非裔美国人领袖、非裔美国人当选官员的策略背后，

sentences.en: and kind of taking them from Joe Biden is this kind of philanthropic juggernaut of Mike Bloomberg.
sentences.zh: 并把他们从乔·拜登那里拉过来，是迈克·彭博这种慈善巨头。

sentences.en: It's being able to indicate or explicitly say that he has been their friend on a lot of other things.
sentences.zh: 这能够表明或明确表示，他在许多其他事情上一直是他们的朋友。

sentences.en: And a lot of other things can involve gun control.
sentences.zh: 而许多其他事情可能涉及枪支管制。

sentences.en: It can involve public education or public health.
sentences.zh: 它可能涉及公共教育或公共卫生。

sentences.en: But a whole lot of that comes out of the activities of Mike Bloomberg's foundation and the activities of his political vehicles.
sentences.zh: 但其中很大一部分来自迈克·彭博基金会的活动和他政治工具的活动。

sentences.en: So this is what you were talking about earlier, Alex, this dilemma that Democrats are facing.
sentences.zh: 所以这就是你之前谈到的，亚历克斯，民主党人面临的这种困境。

sentences.en: It's the same one that progressive groups have been facing for years, groups like Center for American Progress.
sentences.zh: 这与进步团体多年来面临的困境是一样的，比如美国进步中心这样的团体。

sentences.en: How much can they overlook, in terms of Mike Bloomberg's record,
sentences.zh: 在迈克·彭博的记录方面，他们能忽略多少，

sentences.en: in exchange for getting this extraordinary financial support in causes that they believe in and that he believes in?
sentences.zh: 以换取在他们相信的和他相信的事业中获得这种非凡的财政支持？

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: If you believe that the Democratic Party is a party deeply concerned about economic inequality and about the disproportionate concentration of wealth and power in the hands of a small number of people,
sentences.zh: 如果你认为民主党是一个深切关注经济不平等以及财富和权力不成比例地集中在少数人手中的政党，

sentences.en: it seems really incongruous to think that Mike Bloomberg could be a plausible candidate for the nomination, even setting aside issues like stop and frisk or his conduct with women.
sentences.zh: 认为迈克·彭博可能成为提名的合理候选人似乎真的很不协调，即使撇开拦截搜身或他对待女性的行为等问题不谈。

sentences.en: But, but, for a lot of Democratic voters, in an election that they regard as a national emergency,
sentences.zh: 但是，但是，对于许多民主党选民来说，在他们视为国家紧急状态的选举中，

sentences.en: if the only question is, who can beat Trump?
sentences.zh: 如果唯一的问题是，谁能击败特朗普？

sentences.en: People are at least apparently open to the idea that a guy with $60 billion who has shown that he knows how to use it might be that candidate.
sentences.zh: 人们至少表面上愿意接受这样一个想法：一个拥有600亿美元且证明了自己懂得如何运用这笔钱的人，可能就是那位候选人。

sentences.en: And not just a billionaire willing to use that money, but a billionaire who represents their agenda, right?
sentences.zh: 而且不仅仅是一个愿意花钱的亿万富翁，而是一个代表他们议程的亿万富翁，对吧？

sentences.en: I mean, there has for a long time been this anxiety within the Democratic Party, within progressive America, over concentration of wealth, over the power of the oligarchy.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，长期以来，民主党内部、进步派美国内部，对于财富集中、对于寡头政治的权力，一直存在这种焦虑。

sentences.en: But, if the oligarch is their oligarch and spends all his money on their causes, then that really, really complicates this, right?
sentences.zh: 但是，如果这个寡头是“他们自己人”，并且把所有的钱都花在他们的事业上，那这事儿就变得非常、非常复杂了，对吧？

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对是这样。

sentences.en: He has put before Democratic voters a pretty clear proposition, which is that, on the one hand, they may be offended by his wealth and a number of other things about him.
sentences.zh: 他向民主党选民提出了一个非常明确的命题：一方面，他们可能会被他的财富以及关于他的其他一些事情所冒犯。

sentences.en: But if they're offended by his wealth, do they care more about that or about climate change, which he has used his wealth to try to address?
sentences.zh: 但如果他们被他的财富所冒犯，那么他们更在意这一点，还是更在意气候变化？毕竟他已经利用自己的财富试图去解决气候问题了。

sentences.en: In some ways, it's not a perfect comparison, but you could think about it as related to the choice that Republican voters made in embracing Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 在某些方面，这虽然不是一个完美的类比，但你可以把它看作与共和党选民在拥护唐纳德·特朗普时所做的选择有关。

sentences.en: This was a guy who, in almost every outward respect, should have been completely offensive to socially conservative voters who ultimately embraced him.
sentences.zh: 这是一个在几乎所有外在方面，本应让最终拥护他的社会保守派选民感到完全冒犯的人。

sentences.en: And they embraced him because they decided, if we are going to live in this morally degraded, libertine country where our values are under assault,
sentences.zh: 他们拥护他，是因为他们认定：如果我们注定要生活在这个道德沦丧、放荡不羁的国家，而我们的价值观正受到冲击，

sentences.en: well, this guy may be a Hollywood celebrity libertine, but he is our Hollywood celebrity libertine.
sentences.zh: 那么，好吧，这家伙可能是一个好莱坞名流式的浪子，但他可是“我们”好莱坞名流式的浪子。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: There's a pragmatism to it.
sentences.zh: 这其中有一种实用主义。

sentences.en: He was going to do their bidding and effectively has when it comes to things like conservative judges on the Supreme Court.
sentences.zh: 他会按照他们的意愿行事，而且在保守派最高法院法官这类事情上，他实际上也确实做到了。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对是这样。

sentences.en: So if you're convinced that your best option to save the Supreme Court, to deal with climate change, to deal with gun violence,
sentences.zh: 所以，如果你确信拯救最高法院、应对气候变化、解决枪支暴力的最佳选择，

sentences.en: is by embracing a guy who's just going to buy his way to victory on that stuff, well, buying your way to victory might be a more desirable proposition than losing.
sentences.zh: 就是拥护一个打算用钱买通胜利的人，那么，用钱买通胜利可能比失败更令人向往。

sentences.en: You know, it strikes me that this would become an even more complicated issue if Bloomberg,
sentences.zh: 你知道，让我印象深刻的是，如果布隆伯格真的成为了候选人并当选总统，这个问题会变得更加复杂，

sentences.en: and this is by no means assured, in fact, it still seems quite improbable, but who knows, if he becomes a nominee and becomes president.
sentences.zh: 当然这绝非板上钉钉，事实上，这看起来仍然相当不可能，但谁知道呢。

sentences.en: Because then you would have a president who would be among the nation's premier philanthropists, political donors,
sentences.zh: 因为那样的话，你将拥有一位同时也是全国顶级慈善家和政治捐款人的总统，

sentences.en: and there would always be a question hovering over why someone supports him, why someone is endorsing his legislation, showing up at the White House for a signing ceremony, right?
sentences.zh: 而且人们心中总会萦绕着一个疑问：为什么有人支持他？为什么有人会背书他的立法？为什么有人会出现在白宫的签字仪式上，对吧？

sentences.en: And there would always be this sense that he would probably level internal opposition within the world of the Democrats because they would want access to his money.
sentences.zh: 而且总会有一种感觉，他可能会抹平民主党内部的反对声音，因为他们都想从他的钱里分一杯羹。

sentences.en: And potentially level opposition on the other side, too, because we've never had a president who was willing and able to say,
sentences.zh: 而且也可能抹平另一方的反对声音，因为我们从未有过一位总统，既愿意也有能力说：

sentences.en: if you vote for my bill, I will help you win re-election.
sentences.zh: 如果你投票支持我的法案，我就帮你赢得连任。

sentences.en: And if you don't, I will spend $100 million trying to defeat you.
sentences.zh: 如果你不支持，我就花一亿美元试图击败你。

sentences.en: And his message would be, yeah, I'm really rich, so you just have to trust me and you have to trust my moral compass.
sentences.zh: 而他的口号会是：没错，我真的很有钱，所以你们只需要信任我，信任我的道德准则。

sentences.en: It's what's in his ads that we've been talking about.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们一直在谈论的他的广告内容。

sentences.en: He's putting it in front of people right now, this idea that he's a self-made billionaire who has put that money to causes that you, the Democratic primary electorate, care about.
sentences.zh: 他现在正把这个想法摆在人们面前：他是一个白手起家的亿万富翁，已经把钱投入到了你们——民主党初选选民——所关心的事业中。

sentences.en: It doesn't take some great feat of imagination to get voters thinking about what that would mean in the general election and what that could mean for a president.
sentences.zh: 不需要太大的想象力就能让选民思考这意味着什么，以及这对一位总统来说意味着什么。

sentences.en: Thank you, Alex.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，亚历克斯。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: $60 billion can buy you a lot of advertising, but it can't erase your record.
sentences.zh: 600亿美元可以为你买到大量的广告，但它无法抹去你的过往记录。

sentences.en: There's a lot to talk about, Michael Bloomberg.
sentences.zh: 关于迈克尔·布隆伯格，有很多值得讨论的地方。

sentences.en: Over the weekend, after largely ignoring Mike Bloomberg for weeks, the top Democratic presidential candidates, including Joe Biden on Meet the Press,
sentences.zh: 周末期间，在连续几周基本无视迈克·布隆伯格之后，包括乔·拜登在内的民主党总统候选人，在《会见新闻界》节目中，

sentences.en: began attacking him for his past statements and policies, especially stop-and-frisk.
sentences.zh: 开始就他过去的言论和政策攻击他，尤其是“拦截搜身”政策。

sentences.en: His position on issues relating to the African-American community, from stop-and-frisk to the way he talked about Obama.
sentences.zh: 他在涉及非裔美国人社区问题上的立场，从“拦截搜身”到他谈论奥巴马的方式。

sentences.en: At a rally in Las Vegas, Bernie Sanders delivered a similar attack.
sentences.zh: 在拉斯维加斯的一次集会上，伯尼·桑德斯发起了类似的攻击。

sentences.en: Regardless of how much money a multi-billionaire candidate is willing to spend on his election, we will not create the energy and excitement we need to defeat Donald Trump
sentences.zh: 无论一位亿万富翁候选人愿意在选举上花费多少钱，如果我们不能创造出击败唐纳德·特朗普所需的活力和兴奋感，

sentences.en: if that candidate pursued, advocated for, and enacted racist policies like stop-and-frisk, which cause communities of color in his city to live in fear.
sentences.zh: 如果该候选人曾推行、倡导并实施过像“拦截搜身”这样种族主义的政策，导致他所在城市的有色人种社区生活在恐惧之中，那我们就无法获胜。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要知道的其他消息。

sentences.en: More than 1,000 former federal prosecutors and Justice Department officials are calling on Attorney General William Barr to resign
sentences.zh: 超过1000名前联邦检察官和司法部官员呼吁司法部长威廉·巴尔辞职，

sentences.en: over his intervention in the sentencing of Roger Stone, a friend of the president's who was convicted of lying to Congress.
sentences.zh: 原因是他干预了罗杰·斯通的量刑，此人是总统的朋友，被判向国会撒谎。

sentences.en: In a letter released over the weekend, the officials accused Barr and Trump of, quote,
sentences.zh: 在周末发布的一封信中，这些官员指责巴尔和特朗普，引用原话：

sentences.en: Federal prosecutors had originally recommended a sentence of seven to nine years for Stone, prompting Trump to lash out at the Department of Justice
sentences.zh: 联邦检察官最初建议判处斯通七到九年监禁，这促使特朗普抨击司法部，

sentences.en: and Barr to overrule the prosecutors and seek a shorter sentence.
sentences.zh: 而巴尔则推翻了检察官的建议，寻求更短的刑期。

sentences.zh: 以上就是《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.zh: 本周的《Wirecutter秀》，我们正在为假期接待客人做准备。

sentences.zh: 收听节目，获取让客人们感到宾至如归的秘诀。

sentences.zh: 他们是那种需要全黑环境才能入睡的人吗？

sentences.zh: 我不是指他们是不是睡着了就人事不省。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我是说，他们对光线有什么要求？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为那是一个非常具体的问题。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有过敏症或食物敏感吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们是喝咖啡还是喝茶？

sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？
